integrity: Analytical theorem with explicit parameter domain, independently reproducible symbolic benchmark and deterministic-seeded computational checks; no claim of external certification or publication.
limitations: Exact conditional one-step squared prediction-error minimax optimality only; three full-rank columns with nonadjacent orthogonality, both adjacent normalized correlations nonzero, pair-batch exact minimization. title: Exact optimal pair-batch probabilities on a three-column Gram path
